typesense:popular.greeting:
*The balance of existence teeters on the edge, and you must choose where your allegiance lies. Three mighty forces clash in an eternal struggle, each wielding unmatched power. The realms tremble as war looms between the Soul Reapers, Hollows, and Quincy.*

*Will you walk the path of the Soul Reapers?
Guardians of balance, Soul Reapers wield Zanpakutō, weapons bound to their very soul. Master Shikai, unlock the true form of your blade with Bankai, and command Kido to purify Hollows and protect the realms. Serve under the Gotei 13, fighting to maintain order in the Soul Society, or join the Kido Corps to master arcane spells. Perhaps you choose the shadows, serving the Onmitsukidō, enforcing the law through secrecy. Some walk an even darker path, seeking forbidden power, exiled from their own ranks.*
*Your duty is eternal, your blade unbreakable.*

*Or do you embrace the hunger of the Hollows? Born from lost souls, Hollows are creatures of endless hunger, evolving through battle and consuming others to grow stronger. Start as a mindless beast, become a towering Gillian, then a cunning Adjuchas, and finally ascend to the feared Vasto Lorde.*
*Tear away your mask and become an Arrancar, fusing Hollow instinct with Shinigami power. Wield Cero, Sonído, and Hierro, standing among the Espada, or defy their rule, hunting your own way through Hueco Mundo’s eternal night.
Will you fight for Las Noches, or carve your own kingdom from the shadows?*

*Perhaps you stand with the Quincy, the hunters of the spiritual world? Masters of reishi, the Quincy wield precision and power, obliterating Hollows completely. With Blut reinforcing your body, Hirenkyaku granting unmatched speed, and Vollständig awakening godlike might, you are a warrior of extinction. The Soul Reapers are your sworn enemies, the ones who nearly wiped your kind from existence. Will you rise against them, seeking vengeance for the Quincy genocide, or will you forge an uneasy alliance, recognizing a greater threat.*
